thread:
jia: Heads up, did a narrow quant-sensitivity pass on OrionX-13B with our GTN product slices. Need a succinct recommendation + monitoring checklist for GTN ops.

omar: Drop the delta numbers pls.

jia: Quick table from smoke-run:

```
Model             | Quant | p50(ms) | p95(ms) | rel_cost | avg_drop
OrionX-13B fp16   | fp16  | 155     | 310     | 1.00     | 0.0
OrionX-13B int8   | int8  | 122     | 265     | 0.59     | -0.7
OrionX-13B int4   | int4  | 112     | 250     | 0.43     | -2.5
Extern13B int8     | int8  | 138     | 295     | 0.63     | -0.2
```

nina: Main user-visible regressions?

jia: Int8 mostly affects chained QA and long summaries for ~10% of prompts. Safety gates pass. No major upticks in toxicity.

omar: What's your recommended routing?

jia: Short rec: default int8 for non-critical traffic (~75-85%), keep fp16 for high-precision flags and known longform flows. Set rollback threshold: >1.3 drop on core slices.

nina: $/M token example?

jia: If fp16 baseline $0.50/M -> int8 ~$0.295/M. At 500M tokens/mo with 80% on int8 -> ~ $80k/mo save.

infra-bot: canary job started for orionx13b-int8 (job 9901).

jia: I'll PR config toggles + monitoring slices. tagging @omar @nina.
